desc: CMMG has taken portability to a whole new level with the introduction of the DISSENT – a new line of buffer-less AR15 pistols that utilize the company’s patent-pending Compact Action. The DISSENT is available in 5.56x45mm, .300 BLK and 5.7x28mm. The DISSENT is the shortest, most stowable Personal Defense Weapon that CMMG has built to date.
